title: VentureSentimentScore
description: Operator-authored rating against the published Venture Sentiment Score rubric. Lives at /sentiment/score.md (YAML frontmatter) in each engagement repo. Validated server-side by tools/sentiment/validate.js + the api/sentiment-rate.js endpoint. Authoritative source for the headline VSS number rendered on the portal Investability tab.

version.description: Schema version. Increments on breaking shape changes; the validator branches on this. v1 = initial 6-dimension rubric.

profile.description: Funding-stage profile. Drives the default weighting blend if weights are omitted; surfaces in the portal hero as a contextual tag.

ratedBy.description: Operator who authored this rating. Stamped on the portal hero. Provides the editorial-authority signal to investors (who rated this; against what rubric).

ratedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the rating. Drives the sparkline ordering when multiple ratings exist in git history.

dimensions.description: The 6 dimension scores. Each may be null when not-yet-ratable (e.g. Financial Defensibility before Phase 2.5). A null score is rendered as 'pending' on the portal and excluded from the composite. The validator rejects empty/missing keys but accepts null scores.

weights.description: Dimension weights for the composite calculation. Must sum to 1.0 ± 0.01. The operator may override profile defaults by editing these directly.

score.description: 0-100 rating against the published rubric. Null indicates the dimension is not yet ratable (e.g. before the engagement phase that produces the required artefacts).

rationale.description: One-paragraph operator rationale citing rubric clauses + evidence files. MANDATORY when score < 50 (validator enforces). Strongly recommended otherwise.
